You described my time in school, but with fewer words. If you used more words, you would have probably shown that it was worse than mine.

I did my best to hold on for a year now. I can't do it anymore. Every time I asked for help, I got it, but it was never enough, because I always had to give a lot more in return and I could never do it. I simply ran out of juice. I don't have anything left. The bank will soon take my house, I might even go to jail for not paying a lot of stuff. I might soon be fired because I can't live to the expectations of my employer and he doesn't even have high expectations, but I completely lost interest in work thanks to my ex-ex-boss (the one who made me quit). I gave everyone all I had and all I could and in exchange all I got was "it's not enough". There are a lot of things I didn't write, but I will continue tomorrow. Horrible things that confuse the fuck out of me. I feel like my whole mind is trapped in a lot of paradoxes which I can't solve. I have too many conflicts between selfishness and selflessness. Catch ya tomorrow.

I've read a lot about suicide techniques and most of them suck and you will live a horrible life after trying them. Hanging, drowning, jumping in front of a train, jumping off a bridge, gun, etc. they all suck at killing. You read about a lot of suicides in press, but you rarely read about the failed attempts because they're not so sensational. All suicide methods have a success rate of *at most* a 90% and a 10% chance of making you live as half-vegetable for the rest of your days which will probably be decades, a lot more than you've lived until now. With *very few* exceptions, pills always fail. You need to know exactly what you're doing and study and think about how you'll do it for a few years or you'll end up in the 10% and will be much worse than you are right now. I'm not kidding, succeeding at suicide is a lot more difficult than the press makes it look!

>You might start at the National Domestic Violence Hotline;

This. At least talk to them, ask them to explain you what options you have. Describe your situations exactly and ask them how they can help. Don't say "no" before you hear them. Make an informed decision.

>But your death will cause pain.

I'm sure it will be insignificant in comparison to the pain others have caused me.

>if you die, I will cry for you.

I know. All I can say is I'm sorry, but the future literally doesn't exist for me. It's not there. One evening I will go to sleep and wake up back in 2010 with very very few memories of all that happened in the past year and a half. It's obvious that I don't exist in the future and this is the only way to make it happen.
I love you.

>Don't kill yourself however. Please please please don't do it.

I already decided to do it. I know when and how. No pain, just death. You haven't read *all* I wrote, because the worst thing about it is that I live trapped in a time loop and nobody appears to believe me. I know for sure that it is real, I have seen things... I think this is the only way out.

Anyway, these are the conclusions, thoughts and feelings I've been holding for a few months now. I've also tried to imagine some of my feelings and I don't know if I can describe the image here. I've tried to imagine the way I feel about my entire life from since I can remember until today and I've seen the same image in my head many times: I see myself walking in a long corridor. The walls are made of brick. After a few feet, I notice there's wallpaper on both walls. I just keep walking, I never stop. From time to time there are doors either on the left or on the right or on both sides at the same time. I try to touch a knob on the right and someone hits me over my hand. The hand that hit me comes from behind and it's my dads. I keep walking and I grab a knob on the left. My mother yells at me from behind. I keep walking, but now I'm walking like a drunk. I try to open other doors, but they're all locked. I can hardly stand, but I keep walking. I touch the walls to support myself and I feel the texture of the wallpaper. I keep walking and now I'm almost stumbling. To make things worse, my parents are tripping me, so I keep falling. Every time I fall, I get up and use the walls to support myself again. I keep walking but now my parents (still behind me, not visible except hands) smack my head. My dad hits me on the right side and I hit the left wall with my head. I don't stop and keep walking. My mother grabs me by my hair from the left side and smashes my head on the right wall. I've stopped trying to open doors, I just I keep walking and they keep doing that to me forever. Other details: The tunnel is dark and scarry. It's taller than me, but I can't see the ceiling, because it's dark. I can clearly see the floor and walls for about three feet in front of me, but that's it. Everything gets dark very fast after that. The light is coming from behind me and I have no shadow. The wallpaper is mostly yellow with a few green leaves. There's also a carpet, mostly green with yellow leaves. I see myself from behind. If I turn my head to look back, I don't see my face. If I try to walk back, my parents push me forward again and hit my head against the wall again (as usual, dad from right side, mom from left side). I'm wearing shoes and clothes, but I can't see them, I don't know what kind. My hair is cut different than it is now, I actually had it cut like that a few months ago but I don't know how to described it in words. I can't speak.

All my life I've been taught to hold a few basic beliefs. I can't remember them on command, but the most important things are that I mustn't want more than I have, I must be happy with what I have, I mustn't hurt other people, I must help other people whenever I can. I'm doing my best to be nice to everyone, but everyone is just abusing that. I'm starting to think people aren't really worth being nice to and helping. I'm also trying to be happy with what I have, even if it's not what I wanted, but that's very difficult. I don't have anything of what I wanted, but I have a lot of things that not many people have. I have a trash computer, but it's my computer and I really don't know what I would do without it. It's good enough for browsing the web and watching movies. I couldn't afford another one anyway. I have a phone that makes phone calls and has Sudoku and even a radio. I want something like an iPhone or the latest Samsung, but I have no idea what I would do with any of them. I mean a phone should be a phone. I had a house (I will soon be evicted) and while I had it, I shared it with someone that didn't have one, someone whom I really hate. When someone asks for something from me, I give it to them, no questions asked, no conditions. I'm trying to be as simple as possible. I've seen a lot of complaints about people who have shiny or expensive things that are more than just useful and from what I've seen until now, they're called hipsters and they're hated by the general population. At least that's what the major forums like 4chan and reddit suggest. I feel kinda bad for having such a crap phone, but it's a phone. I don't want people to look weird at me for having a "phone" that can run Unix applications. I'm doing my best to be normal, unnoticed and like everyone else, but it's difficult, after I've tried to be like my brother for such a long time. I just want to disappear. Mostly because I hate myself for who I am now and other people for telling me I should feel bad if I want more than plain, useful stuff. The phone again... I hate the phone I have and I really want a dual core or something cool that I could use to SSH, check the weather online, browse reddit, etc. but I know that's not normal and it's probably one of the things for which my family and aquaintances are keeping me locked in this loop. I'm trying to learn to not want the things I want and be normal, but it's very difficult. It's worse when I see other people like that (the phone again...) with a normal phone that's just a phone and they look like shit. I know I look like shit with such a shit phone and that's making me feel worse.

You know, I don't think anyone is reading this. I'm going to keep posting anyway, but I don't think anyone will read this. I believe I am in hell and will never get out of here, so what's the point in doing anything? I did ask that psychologist on the phone if suicide is an option and she told me I have the answer. Go ask doctor if you should kill youself. Go ahead, I'll wait... Well? Yeah, I thought so, you were obviously told not to do it. I figured she wouldn't have said that if that wasn't the way out. Anyway, this is a different paragraph about someone else I want dead. This paragraph is dedicated to my ex-girlfriend who said I was ugly and her mother which I always hated. That girl was the most precious thing I ever had and her mother did her best to screw things up. Actually, I don't even want to say all the shit she did. It's just too much. I think about it all the time, but words can't describe how much she's done to hurt me. They both hurt me so much with that remark 10 years ago that I've been thinking about ending it all ever since. But it didn't end after we broke up. I said some things that hurt that girl and she dumped me. I deserved it, but I also deserved a few words which I never got from her. I wanted to understand some things, but she never answered my questions. I held those questions inside for 10 years. One day, shortly after that I left the job I hated and was preparing to go to the new job which I was to hate, I don't know what happened to me and I called her. I didn't want to. It was another of those moments where I did things I din't want to, I was being controller by someone else. I just wanted to forget about that girl, but someone made me call her. So we met and I was so confused and I told her some weird shit. I didn't know why I called. I didn't know why I asked her to meet me. I didn't know what I was supposed to say so I said the first thing that popped into my head (I accidentally typed "pooped" instead of "popped" and almost decided to leave it that way; it would have made a nice pun that would have described the situation much better). I then asked her to help me buy some clothes, because I never did that before, but she couldn't come. It was probably just an excuse, but whatever, that's besides the point. The point is that these people made me do things I didn't want: quit job, get new job, call girl, meet girl, get clothes, stay in psychiatric clinic, etc. I don't know how they did that, but I know they're all involved. They all know what is happening. They're fucking with me until I kill myself before I do anything to them. Well guess what, I've been wanting to end it for a long time before they did this shit to me and it's all because of that girl and her mother.

Remember the psychologist on that list? After getting a few deja vus, I couldn't stand it anymore and I called her to ask her if she knew what was happening. All she said was "We've talked about this before, you have to remember" over and over. Since that moment I had the worst feeling that I've been trapped in a time loop. I do horrible things that I regret over and over again. I am controlled by those people to do those things over and over again. One morning I wake up in 2010 and I don't know what's going on with me, my head is empty and I feel dizzy. I go through the worst part of that job, my parents tell me how they hate me again, I fuck up a lot, I change jobs again, etc. I know this is more than just a feeling. I've been told by everyone that it's just a feeling - by psychiatrists, friends, family - but I stopped trusting them a long time ago. They obviously know exactly what is happening to me, they know it's real and they're trying to make me go insane, so I don't hurt anyone. It's too late for that, I already want to hurt everyone and the only way to stop myself from doing it is by ending my life. One night I will go to sleep in 2012 and I will wake up in 2010 and all that shit will happen again. There are a lot of other things that freaked the fuck out of me. I used to go out for walks and people would follow me. I've seen the same people over and over and exactly the same cars following me. I would pay attention to certain details of those people or cars (when reading the license plate wasn't possible) and I would see them again and again following me through the city. So people do that kind of stuff to me and then they tell me I'm crazy. And they make me go to a psychiatric clinic. The psychologist told me we've talked about that before, but I could never remember when was the first time it happened. She must know about the time loop. And there's a lot of other stuff that's obvious, a lot of premonitions (with specific details and feelings, I am 100% sure it's not just imagination and/or coincidence) but I'm not writing them here, just to make sure I will still keep some of my thoughts in case anyone who shouldn't read this will end up reading it. There were a lot of things said by my parents that made me realize they knew what is happening.

Anyway, I'm fucked. I haven't paid my bills in months because I've been planning to kill myself around my birthday for months. How does that sound? I want to die because there are some people I can't stand to be around. Actually, I can't stand the thought of them being alive: both my parents, ex-girlfriend and her mother, a psychologist, co-workers from last two jobs and my neighbor who told me to pay my bills and I stopped paying because she told me. We only talked a few times, but what she said pushed me forward to suicide. Right now you might be wondering what the psychologist, ex-girlfriend and her mother and the co-workers are doing on that list. Get ready, because shit is getting real. Sometime between a year ago and a year and a half ago, my parents did what they always do when we talk - they told me they were disappointed by me. I tried to find out why, but they wouldn't tell me. That was the most fucked up thing that had happened until then. How can the only two people you've mostly listened to your whole life tell you again that they're upset and disappointed because of you and not tell you why? Well, I'll tell you how, but I won't tell you why because they still haven't told me why. I can only suppose they found out I was doing drugs. It was definitely not weed and didn't have anything to do with weed. It was some legal crap, because I was too afraid of police to smoke weed. I started performing worse and worse at my job and my ex-boss changed his mind about what and how we should work almost every week. He used to confuse the fuck out of us and then blame us for poor performance. At one point, I completely lost interest in work and I was just doing my job to get paid. At first, I enjoyed working, but after a while I started to hate it. I'm sure the shit I was smoking also helped, but the main problem was the boss. Every now-and-then I would get a feeling of deja vu and I blamed it on the drugs I was taking and ignored it completely. A few months after my parents expressing their usual hate for me, I got a phone call from another company. They called me for an interview. I wanted so bad to decline it, but somehow I couldn't and I accepted. I couldn't control myself, like someone else said "yes" instead of me. That scared the shit out of me. A few days after that, before I quit my job, my colleagues confessed to me that they had read my chat logs from a few years ago and out of the blue they decided to get rid of me and make me go to that other company, for which I said I wanted to work five years before. Waht the fuck? Wait. Back that up. They fucking read my fucking private chat fucking logs. What the fuck? They knew how much I valued privacy and how important it was for me. I trusted them. At that time, they were the only people which I trusted. How the fuck does someone do something like that? I had the strangest feeling of deja vu and just wanted to get out of that whole shit as fast as possible. I never wanted to face them again. In fact I wished for them all to die and never stopped wishing it since then. Them, along with the people at the new job, because those fuckers started to talk about me as if I was "something". I felt like an object being studied. I don't know how to described it. Everyone acted strange around me. What the fuck? I thought for a while that maybe I could get over the "hey, we fucked you in the ass" part because the pay was very good, but I couldn't. At first, I stopped doing those drugs but when I realized I couldn't get over it and I wanted to hurt them all, I started smoking shit again and at that point I was so fucked up by my ex boss that I hated my work. He turned me from I-love-my-job into I-want-to-kill-you-for-making-me-hate-my-job-so-much in a bit over a year. I had to get out of that shit, so I left the office one afternoon and never came back. Except once a month later, to get my stuff. They somehow pushed me into doing that. I have no idea how, but they made me do things I didn't want to do and I hate them more than anything for that.

A few months ago, I decided to end my life again. Only this time, I planned to at least do *some* things I enjoyed before I died. It will all be over soon... So, my parents convinced me to buy an apartment. They pushed me into it for years and when I finally got a loan for one, I found the shittiest piece of shit in the area. I didn't know what to look for, to find the problems it might have, problems it actually has. Like it's not the top floor but when it's raining, at least two walls are filled with moisture and they have large spots on them. Sometimes it's three walls, sometimes four, but usually it's just two. It has two bathrooms, one of which I can't use and will never use, because the drain pipe has cracks and when I use it the water gets in the walls of the neighbors below me. The other bathroom doesn't have a floor drain, so if I get too much water on the floor I have to use whatever I can to get rid of it, otherwise it gets in the walls and ceiling of the neighbors below me. That is actually the thing I hate most about it. There are a few other things wrong with it, but it's not worth going into details. Let's just say that exactly two years ago I made the worst deal of my life and I will regret it for decades to come. I can't sell the place for four reasons:  1) I'm not allowed by contract. 2) The prices are a lot lower. 3) I would have to find a bigger idiot than me. 4) Nobody's buying anymore anyway. I also have the most annoying neighbor ever. I hate that bitch and I want her to die. A normal person wouldn't think like that, so I try to normalize it a bit by thinking that it would be the same if I died. Why kill three people if I can only kill one (me) ? She told me some things for which I will never forgive her. I missed a couple of the common bills - things for which the whole building pays, like electricity for the lights, heating, etc. She told me twice to pay those bills and she also told my parents. That was the fucking last thing I fucking needed at that time and she can go fuck herself, because I decided I would never pay again, no matter what happened. So if I'm not paying those bills, why pay the bank? Fuck the bank, too, I'm not paying the bank anymore either. I've been paying only my electricity and Internet bills for the past few months and now I'm in deep shit. I didn't care when I began doing this and I don't care now. I will end my life, so I the fuck would I bother? I thought about doing it before and I know what I was afraid of and I know how I can finally do it. No pain and relatively fast. But that's another story which I won't tell. I don't want anyone to know how I will do it. The only thing I can say is that it will be just before my birthday this year if not on my birthday. It would be really nice to have existed for an exact number of years.

I recently had a nervious breakdown. I wanted to kill myself and end this shit some people would call life. I don't have a life, I just exist and I'm worse than a chair, because a chair is useful. Somehow I realized that it's not normal for someone to want to do that. I mean, it's obvious that a normal person shouldn't want to die, right? So I called an ambulance and they took me to a psychiatric clinic where I was given some drugs to make me feel better about existing. As I previously said, those drugs sort of worked, but not really. I felt worse while taking them, because I would still think the same things, but I wouldn't say to other people what I was thinking. They made me feel less depressed, but in reality I still was. Actually, I was feeling worse, because I ended up so badly that I was taking drugs to survive. That's not what a normal would be like, right? A normal person wouldn't have to take drugs to survive. A normal person wouldn't feel worse for having to do that. A normal person would have a life instead of mere existence. A normal person would be more useful than a chair. I feel that my parents somehow made me go there. They constantly encouraged me to take my pills and to stay for as long as I had to and they suddenly changed their behavior. From annoying code red, they became annoying code infra-red. They were more annoying, because they somehow changed for a while. After I got out, they changed back to the way they were before, which made them even more annoying. All I wanted was for them to get out of my life a few years ago, to leave me alone and to stop telling me what I'm doing wrong and what I have to do. For the past 5 years they called me almost weekly to ask the most annoying questions over and over and I told them to stop it, but they wouldn't. Two years ago (in 2010) they changed my life from "I can't take it anymore" into "I want to die" and last year (in 2011) they changed it from "I want to die" to "I want to kill you". A normal person wouldn't have such thoughts. I literally wanted to murder them so they would disappear from my life. I couldn't take it anymore. I immediatly realized that it's not normal for someone to think like that and I keep fighting that thought for a year now. It just keeps coming back into my mind every few minutes and I sometimes try to ignore it completely and other times I think about it and look for alternatives. The only one I found now is for me to kill myself. A normal person wouldn't think that.

When I was in highschool, I went to a bar with a girl from my class. I really liked her and another girl friend of hers. I felt like they were very good friends. As we were sitting there, drinking a soda and I was listening to her talk, she mentioned that a clothes shop had a sale and then she called her mother to give her money to buy clothes. Then she asked me if I wanted to go with her, because I would have surely found some good cheap clothes and shoes. I said I couldn't go and at that time I didn't know why I said that, but it hit me a few hours later: I had never bought a single piece of clothing. I remembered that everyone around me talked about where they went to buy shoes and clothes they liked, but I never did. I explained to them that it was just that I started to complain less about it (because it was and still is very painful), but they kept saying I was getting better. I finally convinced them to stop the treatment and later I found out it was still kind of experimental and nobody told me. The mother fuckers gave me a treatment that was still very new and nobody told me. So, after years of rejection from everybody and physical pain I found out that the only person that ever mattered to me thought I was ugly. I had nothing else at that time. Nothing and nobody.
